pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sandiṭṭhā sambhattā bhikkhū Isigilipasse tiṇakuṭiyo karitvā vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.3: āyasmāpi Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto tiṇakuṭikaṃ karitvā vassaṃ upagañchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.4: atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena tiṇakuṭiyo bhinditvā tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca paṭisāmetvā janapadacārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.5: āyasmā pana Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto tatth' eva vassaṃ vasi tattha hemantaṃ tattha gimhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.6: atha kho āyasmato Dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhahāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṃ bhinditvā tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca ādāya agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.7: dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca saṃkaḍḍhitvā tiṇakutikaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.8: dutiyam pi kho āyasmato Dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhahāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṃ bhinditvā tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca ādāya agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.9: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca saṃkaḍḍhitvā tiṇakuṭikaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.10: tatiyam pi kho āyasmato Dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhakāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṃ bhinditvā tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca ādāya agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.11: atha kho āyasmato Dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.12: yāvatatiyakaṃ kho me gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhahāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṃ bhinditvā tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca ādāya agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.13: ahaṃ kho pana susikkhito anavayo sake ācariyake kumbhakārakamme pariyodātasippo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.14: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ sāmaṃ cikkhallaṃ madditvā sabbamattikāmayaṃ kuṭikaṃ kareyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.15: atha kho āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto sāmaṃ cikkhallaṃ madditvā sabbamattikāmayaṃ kuṭikaṃ karitvā tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca gomayañ ca saṃkaḍḍhitvā taṃ kuṭikaṃ paci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.16: sā ahosi kuṭikā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā lohitikā seyyathāpi indagopako,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.1.17: seyyathāpi nāma kiṅkiṇikāsaddo evam eva tassā kuṭikāya saddo ahosi. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ Gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasa taṃ kuṭikaṃ abhirūpaṃ dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ lohitikaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.3: kiṃ etaṃ bhikkhave abhirūpaṃ dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ lohitikaṃ seyyathāpi indagopako 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.6: ananucchaviyaṃ bhikkhave tassa moghapurisassa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.7: kathaṃ hi nāma so bhikkhave moghapuriso sabbamattikāmayaṃ kuṭikaṃ karissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.8: na hi nāma bhikkhave tassa moghapurisassa pāṇesu anuddayā anukampā avihesā bhavissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.10: mā pacchimā janatā pāṇesu pātavyataṃ āpajji.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.11: na ca bhikkhave sabbamattikāmayā kuṭikā kātabbā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.13: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā yena sā kuṭikā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ kuṭikaṃ bhindiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.14: atha kho āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.2.15: kissa me tumhe āvuso kuṭikaṃ bhindathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.1: atha kho āyasmato Dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.2: yāvatatiyakaṃ kho me gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhahāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṃ bhinditvā tiṇañ ca kaṭṭhañ ca ādāya agamaṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.3: yāpi mayā sabbamattikāmayā kuṭikā katā, sāpi bhagavatā bhedāpitā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.4: atthi ca me dārugahe gaṇako sandiṭṭho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.5: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ dārugahe gaṇakaṃ dārūni yācitvā dārukuṭikaṃ kareyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.6: atha kho āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto yena dārugahe gaṇako ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā dārugahe gaṇakaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.7: yāvatatiyakaṃ kho me āvuso gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa tiṇahāriyo kaṭṭhahāriyo tiṇakuṭikaṃ . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.11: n' atthi bhante tādisāni dārūni yān' āhaṃ ayyassa dadeyyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.12: atthi bhante devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṃkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.13: sace tāni rājā dāpeti, harāpetha bhante 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.15: atha kho dārugahe gaṇakassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.16: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.18: na arahati adinnaṃ dinnan ti vattun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.19: atha kho dārugahe gaṇako āyasmantaṃ Dhaniyaṃ kumbhakāraputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.3.21: atha kho āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto tāni dārūni khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ chedāpetvā sakaṭehi nibbāhāpetvā dārukuṭikaṃ akāsi. ||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.1: atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto Rājagahe kammante anusaññāyamāno yena dārugahe gaṇako ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā dārugahe gaṇakaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.3: devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṃkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni kahaṃ tāni dārūnīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.4: tāni sāmi dārūni devena ayyassa Dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dinnānīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.5: atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto anattamano ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.6: kathaṃ hi nāma devo devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṃkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni Dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dassatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.7: atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto yena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.8: saccaṃ kira deva devena devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṃkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni Dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dinnānīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.11: tena hi brāhmaṇa dārugahe gaṇakaṃ āṇāpehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.12: atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto dārugahe gaṇakaṃ baddhaṃ āṇāpesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.4.13: addasa kho āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto dārugahe gaṇakaṃ baddhaṃ niyyamānaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.1: atha kho āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto yena rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.2: atho kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro yenāyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Dhaniyaṃ kumbhakāraputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro āyasmantaṃ Dhaniyaṃ kumbhakāraputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.4: saccaṃ kira mayā bhante devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṃkhārikāni āpadatthāya nikkhittāni ayyassa dinnānīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.6: mayaṃ kho bhante rājāno nāma bahukiccā bahukaraṇīyā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.9: sarasi tvaṃ mahārāja paṭhamābhisitto evarūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitaṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.12: santi bhante samaṇabrāhmaṇā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.14: tesaṃ mayā saddhāya bhāsitaṃ, tañ ca kho araññe apariggahitaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.15: so tvaṃ bhante tena lesena dārūni adinnaṃ harituṃ maññasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.5.16: kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ haneyya vā bandheyya vā pabbājeyya vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.2: alajjino ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dussīlā musāvādino,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.3: ime hi nāma dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā paṭijānissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.4: n' atthi imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ, n' atthi imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.5: naṭṭhaṃ imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ, naṭṭhaṃ imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.6: kuto imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ, kuto imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.7: apagatā ime sāmaññā, apagatā ime brāhmaññā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.8: rājānaṃ p' ime vañcenti, kiṃ pan' aññe manusse 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.9: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.10: ye te bhikkhū appicchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.11: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto rañño dārūni adinnaṃ ādiyissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.12: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Dhaniyaṃ kumbhakāraputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.14: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Dhaniya rañño dārūni adinnaṃ ādiyīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.17: ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.18: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa rañño dārūni adinnaṃ ādiyissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.19: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.20: atha khv' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānañ c' eva apasādāya pasannānañ c' eva ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.21: tena kho pana samayena aññataro purāṇavohāriko mahāmatto bhikkhūsu pabbajito bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.22: atha kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.23: kittakena kho bhikkhu rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro coraṃ gahetvā hanati vā bandhati vā pabbājeti vā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.24: pādena vā bhagavā pādārahena vā atirekapādena vā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.25: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe pañcamāsako pādo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.26: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Dhaniyaṃ kumbhakāraputtaṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.27: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.28.1: yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyyasaṃkhātaṃ ādiyeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.29: yathārūpe adinnādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā coro 'si bālo 'si mūḷho 'si theno 'sīti, tathārūpaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ ādiyamāno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:1.6.31: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||6||1||

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:3.6: ekakuṭiko pi gāmo dvikuṭiko pi gāmo tikuṭiko pi gāmo catukuṭiko pi gāmo, samanusso pi gāmo amanusso pi gāmo, parikkhitto pi gāmo aparikkhitto pi gāmo, gonisādiniviṭṭho pi gāmo, yo pi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho so pi vuccati gāmo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:3.8: parikkhittassa gāmassa indakhīle ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:3.9: aparikkhittassa gāmassa gharupacāre ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:3.11: ṭhapetvā gāmañ ca gāmupacārañ ca avasesaṃ araññaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:3.13: yaṃ adinnaṃ anissaṭṭhaṃ apariccattaṃ rakkhitaṃ gopitaṃ mamāyitaṃ parapariggahitaṃ etaṃ adinnaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:3.17: ādiyeyya hareyya avahareyya iriyāpathaṃ vikopeyya ṭhānā cāveyya saṃketaṃ vītināmeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:3.19: pādaṃ vā pādārahaṃ vā atirekapādaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:3.21: pathavyā rājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mahāmattā ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṃ anusāsanti ete rājāno nāma.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.44.2: gattāni pi cīvarāni pi paṃsukitāni honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.45.1: tena kho pana samayena Campāyaṃ Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā antevāsibhikkhunī Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā upaṭṭhākakulaṃ gantvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.45.7: atha kho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.45.12: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā antevāsibhikkhunī Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā upaṭṭhākakulaṃ gantvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.1: tena kho pana samayena Vesāliyaṃ āyasmato Ajjukassa upaṭṭhākassa gahapatino dve dārakā honti putto ca bhāgineyyo ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.2: atha kho so gahapati āyasmantaṃ Ajjukaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.3: imaṃ bhante okāsaṃ yo imesaṃ dvinnaṃ dārakānaṃ saddho hoti pasanno tassa ācikkheyyāsīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.4: tena kho pana samayena tassa gahapatino bhāgineyyo saddho hoti pasanno. atha kho āyasmā Ajjuko taṃ okāsaṃ tassa dārakassa ācikkhi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.5: so tena sāpateyyena kuṭumbañ ca saṇṭhapesi dānañ ca paṭṭhapesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.6: atha kho tassa gahapatino putto āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.7: ko nu kho bhante Ānanda pituno dāyajjo putto vā bhāgineyyo vā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.9: ayaṃ bhante ayyo Ajjuko amhākaṃ sāpateyyaṃ amhākaṃ methunakassa ācikkhīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.11: atha kho āyasmā Ajjuko āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.12: dehi me āvuso Ānanda vinicchayan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.13: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upāli āyasmato Ajjukassa pakkho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.14: atha kho āyasmā Upāli āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.15: yo nu kho āvuso Ānanda sāmikena imaṃ okāsaṃ itthannāmassa ācikkhā 'ti vutto tassa ācikkhati kiṃ so āpajjatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.16: na bhante kiñci āpajjati antamaso dukkaṭamattam pīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.17: ayaṃ āvuso āyasmā Ajjuko sāmikena imaṃ okāsaṃ itthannāmassa ācikkhā 'ti vutto tassa ācikkhi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.47.1: tena kho pana samayena Bārāṇasiyaṃ āyasmato Pilindavacchassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ corehi upaddutaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.47.3: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho te dārake iddhiyā ānetvā pāsāde ṭhapesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.47.8: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Pilindavaccho corehi nīte dārake ānessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū sahāyakā honti Paṇḍako ca Kapilo ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.3: atha kho tassa bhikkhuno gāmakā Kosambiṃ gacchantassa antarā magge nadiṃ tarantassa sūkarikānaṃ hatthato muttā medavaṭṭi pāde laggā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.7: taṃ uttiṇṇaṃ gopālikā passitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.9: so pakatiyāp' āhaṃ asamaṇo 'ti tassā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.10: Kosambiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.49.1: tena kho pana samayena Sāgalāyaṃ āyasmato Daḷhikassa saddhivihāriko bhikkhu anabhiratiyā pīḷito āpaṇikassa veṭhanaṃ avaharitvā āyasmantaṃ Daḷhikaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.49.6: taṃ agghāpentaṃ na pañca māsake agghati.
